titulo: Sylvan Esso think you should splurge on good-quality yogurt
cuerpo: Amelia Meath and Nick Sanborn, better known as Sylvan Esso, have been bringing their low-key electro-pop to the masses since 2014, bursting onto the scene with their self-titled debut album and the single "Hey Mami."
